I want to write about my experience with the research chemical Flubromazepam. I received my order from a reputable vendor of 25 x 8mg pills. I was super excited to try this chemical out after all of the research I'd done on it. It seemed pretty cool (yeah, 'cool': I'll admit I'm a recreational drug user. I need to stop. Soon. I'm working on it. Its just so fun, you know?)
Anyways.
This is a BIG one. I ate through about 3 or 4 (8mg) pills in a matter of 2 days and I was done. My wife found me passed out in our second bedroom in front of the computer with a ton of porn sites open and me searching for girls personal ads on craigslist, and to top it off I was naked with a sock over my junk. I literally passed the f out.
The substance itself takes about 45m-hour to hit. It isn't like diazepam where it hits in minutes. So I always keep that in mind. Where I went wrong is every time I felt the high start to fade I took another half. What I forgot to account for was its extremely long half life, which in my experience is at about 38-40 hours!!
So.. Here I am having the time of my life just popping half and half... If I count the active dose that was going through me it would've been well above 15-17 mg(?)
This is an extremely high amount to have active in my system.
This experience raised a lot of hell with my wife and I. Very unfortunate.
